mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) may increase valbenazine exposure through CYP3A4/2D6 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while both drugs carry independent CNS and cardiovascular risks.
action: Monitor for increased valbenazine side effects (sedation, orthostatic hypotension, QT prolongation); consider alternative analgesic if possible; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
